<h1 id="编译">编译</h1>
<h2 id="1-测试能否进入-postgresql">1. 测试能否进入 PostgreSQL</h2>
<p>先执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT version();"
</code></pre>
<p>如果能输出 PostgreSQL 版本，说明数据库服务正常。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="2-创建-tpc-h-测试数据库">2. 创建 TPC-H 测试数据库</h2>
<p>你当前 Linux 用户是 <code>username</code>，先检查 PostgreSQL 里有没有同名用户：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo -u postgres psql -c "\du"
</code></pre>
<p>如果里面没有 <code>username</code>，执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo -u postgres createuser -s username
</code></pre>
<p>然后创建数据库：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">createdb tpch
</code></pre>
<p>测试连接：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -c "SELECT current_database(), current_user;"
</code></pre>
<p>正常的话应该看到类似：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text"> current_database | current_user
------------------+--------------
 tpch             | username
</code></pre>
<p>如果 <code>createdb tpch</code> 提示数据库已存在，可以忽略，继续下一步。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-进入-dbgen-目录">3. 进入 dbgen 目录</h2>
<p>你现在在：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">~/TPCH/TPC-H
</code></pre>
<p>进入官方数据生成工具目录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen
ls
</code></pre>
<p>你应该能看到类似这些文件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">makefile.suite
dss.ddl
dss.ri
queries
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="4-编译-tpc-h-工具">4. 编译 TPC-H 工具</h2>
<p>复制 Makefile：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cp makefile.suite Makefile
</code></pre>
<p>编辑：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">vim Makefile
</code></pre>
<p>找到这几行，改成：</p>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">CC      = gcc
DATABASE= POSTGRESQL
MACHINE = LINUX
WORKLOAD = TPCH
</code></pre>
<p>保存退出后执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">make
</code></pre>
<p>编译成功后检查：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ls -l dbgen qgen
</code></pre>
<p>如果能看到 <code>dbgen</code> 和 <code>qgen</code>，说明编译成功。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="修复-qgen-编译失败">修复 qgen 编译失败</h3>
<p>这个问题通常是因为你在 <code>Makefile</code> 里设置了：</p>
<pre><code>DATABASE= POSTGRESQL
</code></pre>
<p>但你这份官方工具源码里没有完整的 PostgreSQL 宏定义，所以 <code>qgen.c</code> 编译时找不到这些宏。</p>
<p>进入目录：</p>
<pre><code>cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen
</code></pre>
<p>先查这些宏定义应该在哪个文件里：</p>
<pre><code>grep -R "SET_ROWCOUNT\|START_TRAN\|GEN_QUERY_PLAN" -n .
</code></pre>
<p>大概率会看到它们在 <code>tpcd.h</code> 或类似头文件里，对 <code>DB2</code>、<code>ORACLE</code>、<code>INFORMIX</code> 有定义，但没有 <code>POSTGRESQL</code>。</p>
<p>然后执行下面这个补丁命令：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cp tpcd.h tpcd.h.bak

cat &gt;&gt; tpcd.h &lt;&lt;'EOF'

/* PostgreSQL definitions added for qgen compile */
#ifdef POSTGRESQL
#define SET_ROWCOUNT "-- SET_ROWCOUNT %d"
#define START_TRAN "BEGIN;"
#define END_TRAN "COMMIT;"
#define SET_DBASE "-- SET_DBASE %s"
#define SET_OUTPUT "\\o"
#define GEN_QUERY_PLAN "EXPLAIN"
#endif
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>然后重新编译：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">make clean
make
</code></pre>
<h2 id="5-生成-sf1-测试数据">5. 生成 SF=1 测试数据</h2>
<p>先跑小规模 1GB：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">./dbgen -s 1
</code></pre>
<p>检查生成的数据文件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ls *.tbl
</code></pre>
<p>然后去掉每行末尾多余的 <code>|</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">for f in *.tbl; do
  sed -i 's/|$//' "$f"
done
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="6-建表并导入数据">6. 建表并导入数据</h2>
<p>建表：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f dss.ddl
</code></pre>
<p>创建导入脚本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat &gt; load.sql &lt;&lt;'SQL'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

\copy region   from 'region.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy nation   from 'nation.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy supplier from 'supplier.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy customer from 'customer.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy part     from 'part.tbl'     with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy partsupp from 'partsupp.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy orders   from 'orders.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy lineitem from 'lineitem.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
SQL
</code></pre>
<p>导入：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f load.sql
</code></pre>
<p>导入完成后建约束：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f dss.ri
</code></pre>
<p>收集统计信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -c "VACUUM ANALYZE;"
</code></pre>
<hr>
<p>你现在建议直接从这里开始执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT version();"
sudo -u postgres psql -c "\du"
sudo -u postgres createuser -s username
createdb tpch
psql -d tpch -c "SELECT current_database(), current_user;"
</code></pre>
<p>如果 <code>createuser</code> 或 <code>createdb</code> 报“already exists”，不是问题，继续往下走。</p>
<h2 id="7-生成数据-建表-导入数据">7. 生成数据 建表 导入数据</h2>
<p>编译成功后：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">./dbgen -s 1
</code></pre>
<p>去掉 <code>.tbl</code> 每行最后的多余 <code>|</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">for f in *.tbl; do
  sed -i 's/|$//' "$f"
done
</code></pre>
<p>建表：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f dss.ddl
</code></pre>
<p>然后导入数据。</p>
<h1 id="数据导入">数据导入</h1>
<h2 id="1-先确认-tbl-文件都在">1. 先确认 <code>.tbl</code> 文件都在</h2>
<p>在当前目录执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ls -lh *.tbl
</code></pre>
<p>应该能看到：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">customer.tbl
lineitem.tbl
nation.tbl
orders.tbl
part.tbl
partsupp.tbl
region.tbl
supplier.tbl
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="2-创建导入脚本">2. 创建导入脚本</h2>
<p>在 <code>~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen</code> 目录下执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat &gt; load.sql &lt;&lt;'SQL'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

\copy region   from 'region.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy nation   from 'nation.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy supplier from 'supplier.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy customer from 'customer.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy part     from 'part.tbl'     with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy partsupp from 'partsupp.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy orders   from 'orders.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy lineitem from 'lineitem.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
SQL
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-执行导入">3. 执行导入</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f load.sql
</code></pre>
<p>这一步会花一点时间，尤其是 <code>lineitem.tbl</code> 有 600 万行左右。</p>
<p>成功时会看到类似：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">COPY 5
COPY 25
COPY 10000
COPY 150000
COPY 200000
COPY 800000
COPY 1500000
COPY 6001215
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="4-检查导入行数">4. 检查导入行数</h2>
<p>导入完成后执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -c "
SELECT 'region' AS table_name, count(*) FROM region
UNION ALL SELECT 'nation', count(*) FROM nation
UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier', count(*) FROM supplier
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer', count(*) FROM customer
UNION ALL SELECT 'part', count(*) FROM part
UNION ALL SELECT 'partsupp', count(*) FROM partsupp
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', count(*) FROM orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'lineitem', count(*) FROM lineitem;
"
</code></pre>
<p>SF=1 正常结果大概是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">region       5
nation       25
supplier     10000
customer     150000
part         200000
partsupp     800000
orders       1500000
lineitem     6001215
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h1 id="postgresql-版主键外键添加">PostgreSQL 版主键外键添加</h1>
<h2 id="1-新建-postgresql-版约束脚本">1. 新建 PostgreSQL 版约束脚本</h2>
<p>因为是先删除，再创建，所以会有这样的信息：</p>
<p>psql:pg_ri.sql:9: NOTICE:  constraint "partsupp_fk2" of relation "partsupp" does not exist, skipping<br>
ALTER TABLE<br>
psql:pg_ri.sql:10: NOTICE:  constraint "customer_fk1" of relation "customer" does not exist, skipping<br>
ALTER TABLE<br>
psql:pg_ri.sql:11: NOTICE:  constraint "supplier_fk1" of relation "supplier" does not exist, skipping</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat &gt; pg_ri.sql &lt;&lt;'SQL'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE lineitem DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lineitem_fk1;
ALTER TABLE lineitem DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lineitem_fk2;
ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS orders_fk1;
ALTER TABLE partsupp DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS partsupp_fk1;
ALTER TABLE partsupp DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS partsupp_fk2;
ALTER TABLE customer DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS customer_fk1;
ALTER TABLE supplier DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS supplier_fk1;
ALTER TABLE nation DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS nation_fk1;

ALTER TABLE lineitem DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lineitem_pkey;
ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS orders_pkey;
ALTER TABLE partsupp DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS partsupp_pkey;
ALTER TABLE part DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS part_pkey;
ALTER TABLE customer DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS customer_pkey;
ALTER TABLE supplier DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS supplier_pkey;
ALTER TABLE nation DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS nation_pkey;
ALTER TABLE region DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS region_pkey;

ALTER TABLE region
  ADD CONSTRAINT region_pkey PRIMARY KEY (r_regionkey);

ALTER TABLE nation
  ADD CONSTRAINT nation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (n_nationkey);

ALTER TABLE supplier
  ADD CONSTRAINT supplier_pkey PRIMARY KEY (s_suppkey);

ALTER TABLE customer
  ADD CONSTRAINT customer_pkey PRIMARY KEY (c_custkey);

ALTER TABLE part
  ADD CONSTRAINT part_pkey PRIMARY KEY (p_partkey);

ALTER TABLE partsupp
  ADD CONSTRAINT partsupp_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ps_partkey, ps_suppkey);

ALTER TABLE orders
  ADD CONSTRAINT orders_pkey PRIMARY KEY (o_orderkey);

ALTER TABLE lineitem
  ADD CONSTRAINT lineitem_pkey PRIMARY KEY (l_orderkey, l_linenumber);

ALTER TABLE nation
  ADD CONSTRAINT nation_fk1
  FOREIGN KEY (n_regionkey) REFERENCES region (r_regionkey);

ALTER TABLE supplier
  ADD CONSTRAINT supplier_fk1
  FOREIGN KEY (s_nationkey) REFERENCES nation (n_nationkey);

ALTER TABLE customer
  ADD CONSTRAINT customer_fk1
  FOREIGN KEY (c_nationkey) REFERENCES nation (n_nationkey);

ALTER TABLE partsupp
  ADD CONSTRAINT partsupp_fk1
  FOREIGN KEY (ps_suppkey) REFERENCES supplier (s_suppkey);

ALTER TABLE partsupp
  ADD CONSTRAINT partsupp_fk2
  FOREIGN KEY (ps_partkey) REFERENCES part (p_partkey);

ALTER TABLE orders
  ADD CONSTRAINT orders_fk1
  FOREIGN KEY (o_custkey) REFERENCES customer (c_custkey);

ALTER TABLE lineitem
  ADD CONSTRAINT lineitem_fk1
  FOREIGN KEY (l_orderkey) REFERENCES orders (o_orderkey);

ALTER TABLE lineitem
  ADD CONSTRAINT lineitem_fk2
  FOREIGN KEY (l_partkey, l_suppkey) REFERENCES partsupp (ps_partkey, ps_suppkey);

COMMIT;
SQL
</code></pre>
<h2 id="2-执行这个新脚本">2. 执行这个新脚本</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f pg_ri.sql
</code></pre>
<p>这一步可能会花一些时间，尤其是 <code>lineitem</code> 表比较大。</p>
<p>成功的话会看到很多：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">ALTER TABLE
</code></pre>
<p>最后看到：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">COMMIT
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-收集统计信息">3. 收集统计信息</h2>
<p>约束加完后执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -c "VACUUM ANALYZE;"
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="4-检查表和约束">4. 检查表和约束</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -c "\dt"
psql -d tpch -c "\d lineitem"
</code></pre>
<p>如果 <code>\d lineitem</code> 里能看到：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">Primary key
Foreign-key constraints
</code></pre>
<p>说明约束已经加成功。</p>
<h1 id="生成查询并修复查询语句">生成查询并修复查询语句</h1>
<p>先执行下面这一整段，生成查询。</p>
<pre><code>cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen

mkdir -p queries_pg results_baseline

for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  echo "Generating Q$i"
  DSS_QUERY=./queries ./qgen -s 1 $i &gt; queries_pg/q$i.sql
done
</code></pre>
<h2 id="1-先修复已经生成的查询文件">1. 先修复已经生成的查询文件</h2>
<p>在当前目录执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen

perl -pi -e "s/interval '([0-9]+)' day \(3\)/interval '\1 day'/g" queries_pg/*.sql
</code></pre>
<p>然后确认 Q1 已经改掉：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">grep -n "interval" queries_pg/q1.sql
</code></pre>
<p>你应该看到类似：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">l_shipdate &lt;= date '1998-12-01' - interval '77 day'
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="2-再跑-q1">2. 再跑 Q1</h2>
<pre><code>psql -d tpch -f queries_pg/q1.sql
</code></pre>
<p>如果 Q1 正常输出结果，就继续批量跑 22 条。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-批量跑-baseline">3. 批量跑 baseline</h2>
<pre><code>mkdir -p results_baseline

for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  echo "Running Q$i baseline"
  /usr/bin/time -f "Q$i elapsed: %e sec" \
    psql -d tpch -f queries_pg/q$i.sql \
    &gt; results_baseline/q$i.out 2&gt; results_baseline/q$i.time
done
</code></pre>
<p>查看耗时：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  echo -n "Q$i: "
  cat results_baseline/q$i.time
done
</code></pre>
<h1 id="q17和q20卡住的处理情况">Q17和Q20卡住的处理情况</h1>
<p>先加一组<strong>针对 TPC-H 常见连接列 + Q18/Q21 的索引</strong>，然后重新 <code>ANALYZE</code>，再单独重跑 Q18、Q21。</p>
<h2 id="1-创建索引脚本">1. 创建索引脚本</h2>
<p>进入目录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen
</code></pre>
<p>创建索引脚本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen

cat &gt; pg_indexes_q17_q20.sql &lt;&lt;'SQL'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

-- Q17: part 过滤 + lineitem 按 partkey/quantity 聚合
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_part_brand_container_partkey
ON part (p_brand, p_container, p_partkey);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lineitem_partkey_quantity_price
ON lineitem (l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice);

-- Q20: part name 前缀匹配 + partsupp + lineitem 日期数量聚合
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_part_name_pattern_partkey
ON part (p_name text_pattern_ops, p_partkey);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_partsupp_partkey_suppkey_availqty
ON partsupp (ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lineitem_part_supp_shipdate_quantity
ON lineitem (l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_shipdate, l_quantity);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_supplier_nation_supp_name
ON supplier (s_nationkey, s_suppkey, s_name);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_nation_name_nationkey
ON nation (n_name, n_nationkey);

VACUUM ANALYZE;
SQL


</code></pre>
<pre><code>psql -d tpch -f pg_indexes_q17_q20.sql
</code></pre>
<p>建完索引后最好再执行一次</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -c "VACUUM ANALYZE;"
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-重新跑-q17-和-q20">3. 重新跑 Q17 和 Q20</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p results_q17_q20

/usr/bin/time -f "Q17 elapsed: %e sec" \
  psql -d tpch -f queries_pg/q17.sql \
  &gt; results_q17_q20/q17.out \
  2&gt; results_q17_q20/q17.time

/usr/bin/time -f "Q20 elapsed: %e sec" \
  psql -d tpch -f queries_pg/q20.sql \
  &gt; results_q17_q20/q20.out \
  2&gt; results_q17_q20/q20.time

cat results_q17_q20/q17.time
cat results_q17_q20/q20.time
</code></pre>
<h2 id="4-再跑一轮完整-indexed-结果">4. 再跑一轮完整 indexed 结果</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p results_indexed

for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  echo "Running Q$i indexed"
  /usr/bin/time -f "Q$i elapsed: %e sec" \
    env PGOPTIONS='-c statement_timeout=30min' \
    psql -d tpch -f queries_pg/q$i.sql \
    &gt; results_indexed/q$i.out \
    2&gt; results_indexed/q$i.time

  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Q$i TIMEOUT or ERROR" &gt;&gt; results_indexed/q$i.time
  fi
done
</code></pre>
<p>查看汇总：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  echo "===== Q$i ====="
  cat results_indexed/q$i.time
done
</code></pre>
<h1 id="切换负载因子">切换负载因子</h1>
<p><strong>强烈建议这样做</strong>：保留两个数据库，分别放 SF=1 和 SF=10。</p>
<p>比如：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">tpch    -&gt; SF=1
tpch10  -&gt; SF=10
</code></pre>
<p>这样以后不用来回清空、导入，只需要连接不同数据库。</p>
<h2 id="你现在已有-sf1-数据库">你现在已有 SF=1 数据库</h2>
<p>你现在的 <code>tpch</code> 就保留为 SF=1：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch
</code></pre>
<p>SF=10 新建一个数据库：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">createdb tpch10
</code></pre>
<p>如果已经存在并且你想重建：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dropdb tpch10
createdb tpch10
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="1-生成-sf10-数据到单独目录">1. 生成 SF=10 数据到单独目录</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen

mkdir -p data_sf10

rm -f data_sf10/*.tbl

./dbgen -s 10

mv *.tbl data_sf10/

cd data_sf10

for f in *.tbl; do
  sed -i 's/|$//' "$f"
done
</code></pre>
<p>注意：这里会把当前目录下新生成的 <code>.tbl</code> 移动到 <code>data_sf10/</code>。你原来 SF=1 数据已经在 PostgreSQL 的 <code>tpch</code> 数据库里了，所以不受影响。</p>
<h2 id="2-生成查询">2. 生成查询</h2>
<p>直接生成 SF=10 查询即可：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen

mkdir -p queries_pg_sf10

for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  DSS_QUERY=./queries ./qgen -s 10 $i &gt; queries_pg_sf10/q$i.sql
done

perl -pi -e "s/interval '([0-9]+)' day \(3\)/interval '\1 day'/g" queries_pg_sf10/*.sql
</code></pre>
<p>生成后检查：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ls -lh queries_pg_sf10/q1.sql
ls queries_pg_sf10
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-在-tpch10-里建表">3. 在 tpch10 里建表</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd ~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen

psql -d tpch10 -f dss.ddl
</code></pre>
<p>如果提示表已存在，说明 <code>tpch10</code> 不是空的。可以重建：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dropdb tpch10
createdb tpch10
psql -d tpch10 -f dss.ddl
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="4-导入-sf10-数据">4. 导入 SF=10 数据</h2>
<p>创建导入脚本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat &gt; load_sf10.sql &lt;&lt;'SQL'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

\copy region   from 'data_sf10/region.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy nation   from 'data_sf10/nation.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy supplier from 'data_sf10/supplier.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy customer from 'data_sf10/customer.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy part     from 'data_sf10/part.tbl'     with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy partsupp from 'data_sf10/partsupp.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy orders   from 'data_sf10/orders.tbl'   with (format csv, delimiter '|');
\copy lineitem from 'data_sf10/lineitem.tbl' with (format csv, delimiter '|');
SQL
</code></pre>
<p>执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch10 -f load_sf10.sql
</code></pre>
<hr>
<p>结果：</p>
<pre><code>region    5
nation    25
supplier  100000
customer  1500000
part      2000000
partsupp  8000000
orders    15000000
lineitem  59986052
</code></pre>
<h2 id="5-给-tpch10-加主键外键">5. 给 tpch10 加主键外键</h2>
<p>你之前的 PostgreSQL 版约束脚本 <code>pg_ri.sql</code> 可以复用：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch10 -f pg_ri.sql
</code></pre>
<p>加索引：</p>
<pre><code>psql -d tpch10 -f pg_indexes_q17_q20.sql
</code></pre>
<p>然后收集统计信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch10 -c "VACUUM ANALYZE;"
</code></pre>
<p>运行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p results_indexed_sf10

for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  echo "Running Q$i indexed"
  /usr/bin/time -f "Q$i elapsed: %e sec" \
    env PGOPTIONS='-c statement_timeout=30min' \
    psql -d tpch10 -f queries_pg/q$i.sql \
    &gt; results_indexed/q$i.out \
    2&gt; results_indexed/q$i.time

  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Q$i TIMEOUT or ERROR" &gt;&gt; results_indexed/q$i.time
  fi
done
</code></pre>
<h2 id="6-查询时怎么区分-sf1-和-sf10">6. 查询时怎么区分 SF=1 和 SF=10</h2>
<p>连接 SF=1：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch
</code></pre>
<p>连接 SF=10：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch10
</code></pre>
<p>跑 SF=1 查询：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch -f queries_pg/q1.sql
</code></pre>
<p>跑 SF=10 查询：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">psql -d tpch10 -f queries_pg_sf10/q1.sql
</code></pre>
<h2 id="6-以后目录建议这样放">6. 以后目录建议这样放</h2>
<pre><code class="language-text">~/TPCH/TPC-H/dbgen/
├── data_sf10/             # SF=10 的 .tbl 数据文件
├── queries_pg/            # SF=1 查询
├── queries_pg_sf10/       # SF=10 查询
├── results_baseline/      # SF=1 结果
├── results_sf10_baseline/ # SF=10 结果
├── tpch 数据库             # SF=1
└── tpch10 数据库           # SF=10
</code></pre>


</div>
